summary: SSH-capable prints keep golang.org/x/crypto at v0.56.0 or newer.
reason: The GL.iNet transport reaches ssh.NewClientConn, so older crypto releases expose GO-2026-6354 and GO-2026-6355 channel-deadlock denial of service paths.
validated_outcome: govulncheck v1.3.0 reports zero reachable vulnerabilities for the GL.iNet module.
